answer.sql:
WITH claim_policy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cc.Claim_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number
  FROM claim_coverage cc
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  JOIN policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_amounts AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
  FROM claim_amount ca
  LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_premiums AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
  SELECT
    a.Product_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%policy holder%'
        THEN COALESCE(o.Organization_Name, CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name), CAST(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR))
      END
    ) AS policy_holder,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%agent%'
        THEN COALESCE(o.Organization_Name, CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name), CAST(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR))
      END
    ) AS agent_who_sold_it
  FROM agreement a
  JOIN agreement_party_role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = a.Product_Identifier
  JOIN party_role pr
    ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
  LEFT JOIN party pt
    ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN person pe
    ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN organizations o
    ON o.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  GROUP BY a.Product_Identifier
)
SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
  pp.policy_holder,
  pp.premium_amount_paid,
  pp.agent_who_sold_it,
  ca.loss_payment_amount,
  ca.loss_reserve_amount,
  ca.expense_payment_amount,
  ca.expense_reserve_amount
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_policy cp
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums pp
  ON pp.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_parties ppr
  ON ppr.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, cp.Policy_Number;

SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  AVG(date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS average_days_to_settle
FROM claim AS c
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
  ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
JOIN policy AS p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  COALESCE(SUM(ca.Claim_Amount), 0) AS total_loss
FROM claim AS c
LEFT JOIN claim_amount AS ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
 AND (
   EXISTS (
     SELECT 1
     FROM loss_payment AS lp
     WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
   )
   OR EXISTS (
     SELECT 1
     FROM loss_reserve AS lr
     WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
   )
   OR EXISTS (
     SELECT 1
     FROM expense_payment AS ep
     WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
   )
   OR EXISTS (
     SELECT 1
     FROM expense_reserve AS er
     WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
   )
 )
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.Policy_Identifier) AS average_policy_size
FROM policy_amount AS pa
JOIN premium AS p
  ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier;

JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr

WITH policy_claims AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    cc.Claim_Identifier
  FROM policy p
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
  JOIN claim_coverage cc
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
claim_losses AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss
  FROM claim_amount ca
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment ep WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve er WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)

  pc.Policy_Number,
  AVG(cl.loss) AS average_loss
FROM policy_claims pc

  ON cl.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier

WITH claim_totals AS (

  )
     OR EXISTS (

    WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
     OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment ep
    WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
     OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve er
    WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  )
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_premiums AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
  NULL AS policy_holder,
  ct.total_loss,
  COALESCE(pp.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid
FROM claim c
JOIN claim_totals ct
  ON ct.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
  ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
 AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
JOIN policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums pp
  ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
  c.Company_Claim_Number,

  ct.total_loss,

answer.sql:
WITH claim_amounts AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
  FROM claim_amount ca
  LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premium_amounts AS (
  SELECT
    pa.Policy_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
  FROM policy_amount pa
  JOIN premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
  p.Policy_Number,
  ca.Loss_Payment_Amount,
  ca.Loss_Reserve_Amount,
  ca.Expense_Payment_Amount,
  ca.Expense_Reserve_Amount,
  pm.Premium_Amount_Paid
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_coverage cc
  ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_amounts pm
  ON pm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  p.Policy_Number,
  pa.Policy_Amount AS Premium,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
        OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
        OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
        OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
      THEN ca.Claim_Amount
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS Total_Loss,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
        OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
        OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
        OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
      THEN ca.Claim_Amount
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) / NULLIF(pa.Policy_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM policy p
JOIN policy_amount pa
  ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN premium pr
  ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage cc
  ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim c
  ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_amount ca
  ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp
  ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr
  ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep
  ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er
  ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number, pa.Policy_Amount;
